highlights: in need of some cosmetic refurbishment
summary: Situated within an established residential setting in Hartlepool, this three-bedroom mid-terraced home offers spacious and versatile accommodation together with an enclosed rear garden.
description:
This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.

Requiring some cosmetic refurbishment, the property presents an exciting opportunity for a new owner to modernise and personalise the accommodation to their own taste and requirements, whilst offering particularly interesting potential for investors seeking a property with scope to add value. The property is conveniently located for a range of everyday amenities and services, with local shops, schools and recreational facilities all within the surrounding area. There are a number of nearby green spaces, local parks and recreational areas. The property is also conveniently positioned for Hartlepool's wider range of shopping, leisure and entertainment facilities. Internally, the accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance lobby, leading into a spacious lounge, whilst to the rear is an open-plan kitchen/dining room, providing a sociable area for everyday living and entertaining. The ground floor is completed by a family bathroom. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms, providing excellent flexibility for families, guests or those requiring space for a home office or study. The layout also makes the property particularly appealing to investors looking for a three-bedroom rental opportunity. Externally, the property benefits from an enclosed rear garden, providing valuable outdoor space and further enhancing the property's appeal to families and owner-occupiers. With its three-bedroom layout, good-sized living accommodation, enclosed rear garden and scope for cosmetic improvement, this property offers an excellent opportunity for buyers looking to create a home to their own specification. Investors in particular may find the property attractive, with the potential to improve and enhance the accommodation before letting or resale. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the space, versatility and potential on offer.

ENTRANCE The property is accessed via a composite entrance door, leading into a welcoming entrance lobby that provides an inviting introduction to the accommodation beyond.

ENTRANCE LOBBY Offering a practical transition into the home, the lobby creates a useful entrance space before leading into the principal living accommodation, setting the tone for the property's well-proportioned layout and excellent potential for a new owner to personalise and enhance to their own taste.

KITCHEN / DINING ROOM The kitchen/dining room provides a practical and versatile space, offering ample room for a dining table and chairs and creating a sociable area for everyday family meals and entertaining. The kitchen is fitted with a basic range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces incorporating an inset sink with drainer and mixer tap. Integrated cooking appliances include an oven and hob, whilst there is also plumbing for an automatic washing machine. A wall-mounted gas combination central heating boiler is conveniently positioned within the room. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light into the kitchen, whilst a door provides direct access to the rear garden. Tiled flooring adds a practical finish to the kitchen area. With its useful layout and direct garden access, this room offers excellent scope for cosmetic updating and provides an exciting opportunity for a new owner to create a modern kitchen/dining space tailored to their own requirements.

LOUNGE The lounge is a well-proportioned reception room offering a comfortable and welcoming space for relaxing and entertaining. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere. A feature fire surround with inset and hearth provides an attractive focal point and adds character to the room, whilst a radiator ensures warmth and comfort. With its generous proportions and scope for cosmetic enhancement, this inviting reception room offers an excellent opportunity for a new owner to personalise the space to their own taste.

GROUND FLOOR BATHROOM The ground floor bathroom is fitted with a practical white suite comprising a panelled bath, wash hand basin and low-level WC. Part-tiled walls provide a practical finish, whilst a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light into the room. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, and the room offers a good foundation for further cosmetic updating, allowing a new owner the opportunity to create a contemporary bathroom tailored to their own taste and requirements.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing provides access to all three bedrooms, creating a practical and well-connected layout to the upper accommodation. The landing leads naturally from the staircase to each of the bedrooms, offering a convenient central point within the first floor.

BEDROOM ONE A well-proportioned principal bedroom offering a comfortable and versatile space with ample potential to create a relaxing retreat. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light to brighten the room, creating a pleasant and airy atmosphere. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, whilst the room offers an excellent blank canvas for a new owner to introduce their own style and choice of furnishings.

BEDROOM TWO A further well-proportioned bedroom offering a comfortable and versatile space, ideal for family members, guests or those requiring a dedicated home office or study. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows plenty of natural light to enter, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere. A radiator provides warmth and comfort throughout the year, whilst the room offers a blank canvas for a new owner to personalise and enhance to their own taste. This versatile second bedroom further complements the property's practical three-bedroom layout.

BEDROOM THREE Completing the first-floor accommodation is a further well-proportioned bedroom, offering a comfortable and versatile space that could be ideally suited as a child's bedroom, guest room, home office or hobby room. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window provides plenty of natural light, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere, whilst a radiator ensures warmth and comfort. As with the remainder of the property, this room offers an excellent opportunity for a new owner to add their own decorative style and further enhance the space to suit individual requirements.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from an enclosed rear garden, providing a private and pleasant outdoor space for relaxation and entertaining. A paved area offers an ideal setting for outdoor seating and dining, whilst the remainder of the garden is predominantly laid to lawn and complemented by established trees and shrubbery. The enclosed nature of the garden provides a good degree of privacy and creates a versatile outdoor area with scope for further landscaping or planting to suit individual tastes. This attractive garden is a valuable addition to the property and further enhances its appeal to both owner-occupiers and potential investors.
